u0: The agent does not carry the yellow key and the door has not been opened. Find the key on the starting side and pick it up; if the key was previously dropped before opening the door, reacquire it. Picking it up advances to u1.
u1: The agent carries the yellow key while the door is still closed. Keep possession of the key, navigate to the locked yellow door, and toggle it open to advance to u2; dropping the key before the door is open loses progress and returns to u0.
u2: The door has been opened at least once, and the agent has not yet reached the goal. Proceed through the door toward the green goal; if the door is currently shut, reopen it first. Reaching the goal advances to the terminal state u3, while the key is no longer required.
u3: Terminal success: the agent has reached the goal after opening the door, and the episode ends on this step. There is no further objective or action to take.
